Your screenshot shows a second fault too: the card scrolls sideways. The quote line is cut at "new on", and there are two horizontal scrollbars, one under the thread and one under the reply box.

Why it slipped: my brief for the fix covered how the card opens and how tall it gets, and nothing in it scrolled the page. So no check ever saw the card move during a scroll, or saw it overflow sideways. That's on me, not the rules.

- While the page scrolls, the card moves with its pin in the same frame, as if it were part of the page. Where it has to stop at an edge, it eases there and never snaps.
- Nothing in the card scrolls sideways: long lines wrap and the reply box fits.

The checks will now scroll the page and read the card's position on every frame, and sweep for anything sideways at all three widths.
